diagnostics.message: op.create_index in upgrade() either blocks writes to the table while PostgreSQL builds the index, or runs CONCURRENTLY inside the transaction of the migration, where PostgreSQL refuses it. Pass postgresql_concurrently=True and put the call inside `with op.get_context().autocommit_block():`.
